text:
Alyssa: quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Alyssa: Did: published python quickstart draft (v0.4) + added streaming example and minimal sampleapp that uses the SDK streaming helper.
Alyssa: Blocker: mac M1 CI on sampleapp fails during wheel build, hitting a native lib error. can't reproduce locally on intel.
Alyssa: Today: triage CI, fix packaging, update quickstart wording + tiny screenshot tweak.

Jordana: can you paste the failing snippet? might be the cibuild flags.

Alyssa: logs: ```ERROR: Failed building wheel for redwood-sdk-sampleapp
  clang: error: unsupported option '-static-libgcc'
  note: building for platform macosx-11-arm64 but wheel tags are for x86_64```

Mike: I looked — sounds like our build matrix isn't setting PLATFORM_ARCH properly. I can open a PR to adjust buildx and the wheel tags. assigning to myself.

Sam: FYI I restarted the mac runner once (flaky runner), reran job 9, same failure. not a transient runner issue.

Luis: For the quickstart copy: prefer "pip install redwood-sdk" (single line) and call out minimum Python 3.10. Also add note about M1 devs and universal2 wheels.

Alyssa: good call. I'll add the note and a short troubleshooting section.

Mike: opening PR now: #4287 — fixes wheel tag logic + adds universal2 build in workflow. I'll link when done.

docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken internal link in quickstarts (samples/streaming -> samples/stream) — created issue #1529.

Jordana: nice catch docs-bot. Alyssa can you update the redirect or change docs to point to /stream ?

Alyssa: yes will change to /stream and mirror a redirect alias in the sidebar.

Sam: also noticed one flaky snapshot in sampleapp tests (timestamps in output). I'll work on making snapshots deterministic — might be a small test harness change.

Alyssa: sweet. blockers getting smaller. tagging tasks: @Mike handle build matrix, @Sam fix snapshots, @Luis quick wording PR, @Jordana review docs links.

Mike: ack, expect PR by EOD PST.

Luis: will send wording PR after lunch.

Jordana: will review once PRs are up.

Alyssa: thanks team :thumbsup: — will post final status when PRs land and CI green.
